text:
Situation: Losartan potassium 25 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 113 tablets at 10.6 tablets per day, providing 10.6 days on hand. Corvale General holds 361 tablets at 13.7 tablets per day, providing 26.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show losartan potassium is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale East is below a comfortable buffer. Corvale General has adequate supply for the near term. Three ranked alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list, but only Macleods and Strides have identifiable plants with recent VAI inspections.

Recommended actions:
1. Verify current physical inventory at Corvale East and Corvale General against the 10.6-day and 26.3-day projections. (Buyer)
2. Qualify Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited for immediate purchase; its plant was last inspected with a VAI classification on 2023-10-20. (Buyer, P&T Committee)
3. Qualify Strides Pharma Science Limited as a secondary source; its plant Strides Alathur Private Limited was last inspected VAI on 2024-04-05. (Buyer, P&T Committee)
4. Defer qualification of AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., and Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited until plant locations can be confirmed. (Buyer)

Not recommended: No allocation changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
